## Delivery

Follow the shared [release contract](../ops/RELEASE.md). Report local completion,
GitHub completion, and online release separately. Record pending work explicitly;
merging this PR does not authorize deployment. Confirm the final head CI, then
the exact merge-SHA push CI. Exclude credentials, production config, ledgers,
real chats and unrelated worktree edits.
